zh.title: 瑞士國際航空波音777客機出現異味 備降亞速群島
zh.summary: 瑞航波音777班機因異味備降亞速群島；部分人員接受檢查；已調派替換機
body: 瑞士國際航空（SWISS）一架由芝加哥飛往蘇黎世的波音777-300ER客機（國籍標誌暨登記號碼HB-JNF），於2026年8月25日因經濟艙散發刺鼻異味，緊急轉降位於亞速群島特塞拉島的拉傑斯機場（TER）。機組員向空中交通管制宣佈緊急狀態以獲得優先處理，客機於當地時間06:30安全降落。
機上載有222名乘客與16名機組員，均正常下機。瑞士國際航空指出，約5名乘客與1名機組員出現眼部刺激、噁心和頭痛症狀並接受預防性醫療檢查，無人需要進一步治療。航空公司表示目前尚無法確定異味來源，專家將進行徹底檢查，同時已調派替換客機接載旅客，並取消當日LX8往返航班。

en.title: SWISS Boeing 777 Diverts to Azores Following Odor in Cabin
en.summary: A SWISS Boeing 777 diverted to the Azores due to cabin odor, prompting precautionary passenger medical checkups.
body: A SWISS Boeing 777-300ER, registered HB-JNF, operating Flight LX9 from Chicago to Zurich, diverted to Lajes Airport (TER) in the Azores on August 25, 2026. The flight crew declared an emergency to obtain priority air traffic control handling after a pungent odor spread through the economy cabin. The aircraft landed safely at 06:30 local time.

All 222 passengers and 16 crewmembers disembarked normally. SWISS reported that approximately five passengers and one crewmember underwent precautionary medical examinations after experiencing brief symptoms including eye irritation, nausea, and headaches, though none required further treatment. The airline dispatched a replacement aircraft to collect the passengers while investigating the source of the odor, and cancelled its August 25 LX8 round-trip service.

facts.claim: 瑞航一架波音777-300ER客機從芝加哥飛往蘇黎世途中，因經濟艙出現刺鼻異味，於2026年8月25日轉降亞速群島拉傑斯機場。
facts.sourceQuote: A SWISS Boeing 777-300ER flying from Chicago to Zurich diverted to the Azores on August 25, 2026, after what the airline described as a “pungent odor” spread through the economy-class cabin

facts.claim: 機組員宣佈緊急狀態以獲優先管制處置，客機（註冊號HB-JNF）於當地時間06:30安全降落，機上222名乘客與16名機組員正常下機。
facts.sourceQuote: The pilots declared an emergency to be given priority handling from air traffic control. The aircraft, registered HB-JNF, landed safely at Lajes at 06:30 local time

facts.claim: 約5名乘客與1名機組員出現眼部刺激、噁心和頭痛症狀並接受預防性檢查，無人需進一步治療。
facts.sourceQuote: SWISS said approximately five passengers and one crewmember underwent precautionary medical examinations after briefly experiencing symptoms that included eye irritation, nausea and headaches.

facts.claim: 瑞航表示尚無法確定異味原因將全面檢查，並已自蘇黎世派遣替代客機前往特塞拉島接載乘客與機組員。
facts.sourceQuote: SWISS dispatched a replacement aircraft from Zurich to collect the passengers and crew from Terceira.

facts.claim: 本次意外調度導致瑞航取消8月25日從蘇黎世飛往芝加哥的LX8班機及其後續回程航班。
facts.sourceQuote: The disruption also forced the airline to cancel its August 25 Flight LX8 from Zurich to Chicago and the subsequent return flight.
